name: Attack
note: Skill #1 corresponds to the Attack command.

name: Guard
note: Skill #2 corresponds to the Guard command.

name: Turnip Toss
description: Throws a turnip very hard at one enemy. It is what he has.

name: Plot Armor
description:
The party is briefly too important to the story to be hurt
properly.

name: Heroic Second Wind
description: Stands back up, dusts himself off, and gets on with it.

name: The Power of Friendship
description:
Damages every enemy. Scales with how many people came along,
which is the entire moral of most of these stories.

name: Destined Strike
description:
The blow the prophecy specifically mentions. Always finds
its mark.

name: Bedside Manner
description: Restores an ally's HP while explaining what they did wrong.

name: Aggressive Hydration
description: Restores HP to the whole party, whether or not they asked.

name: Stern Word
description:
Light damage to one enemy, delivered in the tone of a
disappointed aunt.

name: Get Up
description:
Revives a fallen ally. The dying is, she says, mostly
attitude.

name: Prescribed Rest
description: Clears an ally's afflictions and tells them to sit down.

name: Homily
description: Light damage to every enemy. Runs slightly long.

name: Anvil Drop
description:
Hits one enemy with an anvil. Where the anvil comes from is
his business.

name: Percussive Maintenance
description:
Restores an ally's HP by striking them in a knowledgeable
place.

name: Full Swing
description:
Swings at everything in front of him. Accuracy is not the
point.

name: Quench
description: Braces up. Raises his own defence sharply and steadies him.

name: Reforge The Moment
description: The single hardest thing anyone in this village can do.

name: Kindle
description: A modest fire, aimed carefully.

name: Frostbite
description: Ice, in one specific place.

name: Static
description: A great deal of static.

name: Conflagrate
description:
Fire, to every enemy, all at once. This is the one she was
expelled for.

name: Extremely Unstable Meteor
description:
Enormous damage to every enemy, give or take. Mostly give.
Sometimes take.

name: Mana Sip
description:
Takes a little magic back off an enemy who was not using it
well.

name: Backstab
description: One precise hit from a direction nobody was watching.

name: Reallocate
description: Relieves an enemy of funds it was not going to spend anyway.

name: Twelve Fingers
description: Four quick strikes, at whatever happens to be nearest.

name: Vanish
description: Becomes markedly harder to hit and slightly harder to find.

name: Coup de Grace
description: Hits harder the worse the target is already doing.

name: Interpose
description:
Stands in front. Takes hits meant for the others, on
principle.

name: Oath of Nearly-Certain Victory
description: Raises the party's defence, at some length.

name: Righteous Charge
description:
A charge, in a direction that is at least approximately
correct.

name: Rally
description:
Raises the party's attack with a short and very sincere
speech.

name: Chivalric Finisher
description: Everything he has been holding back, plus his armour.

name: Ballad of Adequacy
description:
Raises the party's attack. The lyrics are honest about the
odds.

name: Discordant Note
description: One truly awful chord. Every enemy's defence suffers for it.

name: Previously, On This Quest
description:
Recaps events so far. The party is restored by the reminder
that they have survived worse.

name: Lullaby of Mild Tedium
description: A song about crop rotation. One enemy falls asleep.

name: Epic Finale
description: The last verse, at volume, to every enemy present.

name: Foreshadowing
description:
Hints ominously at what is coming. The party braces
accordingly.

name: Brood
description:
Says nothing, meaningfully. His attack rises, his guard
drops, and the moment finds him ready.

name: Black Edge
description:
A dark, unhurried cut. He has practised this alone for
eleven years and it shows, which is the sad part.

name: Old Wound
description:
Opens the scar on purpose: costs him a sixth of his health
and fills his resolve. A terrible way to run a person.

name: Ominous Remark
description:
Says something about the coming dark to nobody in
particular. Every enemy attacks worse for a while.
message1: %1 says something about the coming dark.

name: Prophesied Rival
description:
The blow he has been saving. Hits hardest when he is nearly
finished, which he considers correct.

name: Everything At Once
description:
Stops holding back. Dark damage to every enemy, and a
slightly embarrassing amount of shouting.

name: Snap Shot
description:
Two bolts, quickly, at one specimen. Costs nothing, which
she considers good practice.

name: Field Notes
description:
Writes one enemy up properly. Being described accurately
does measurable harm to a creature's defences.

name: Pin It Down
description:
A bolt through something structural. Damage, and the
specimen is markedly slower about everything afterwards.

name: Preserve A Specimen
description:
Applies the preserving fluid early, on the grounds that it
saves time later. Poisons one enemy.

name: Volley
description:
Empties the quiver across the whole field. Wasteful. She
retrieves every bolt afterwards and will say so.

name: The Definitive Entry
description:
The last word on a species, delivered at range. Nothing
survives being described this thoroughly.

name: Guest Appearance
description:
Arrives in the fight properly, with light behind him. It is
a lot to watch and it does a lot of damage.

name: Heroic Encouragement
description:
Heals the whole party and means every word of it. Guest
characters always have one of these.
message1: %1 tells everyone they are doing well.

name: Unnecessary Flourish
description:
Hits every enemy in a way that is objectively more elaborate
than the situation calls for.

name: Prior Engagement
description:
Everything he has, at once, quickly, because he has to be
somewhere.
message1: %1 checks the time, and finishes it.

name: A Strong Opinion
message1: %1 has a strong opinion about this.
